question: India hosted part of the International Army Games for the first time in 2019. In which city were the games held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaisalmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jaisalmer** is a city in the Indian state of Rajasthan, known for its golden sand dunes and historic forts.
 
• The **International Army Games** is an annual event organized by the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation, involving various military competitions.
 
• In 2019, India hosted a part of these games for the first time, and the event was held in the city of **Jaisalmer**.
 
• The event in Jaisalmer saw participation from multiple countries, showcasing their military strength and skills in different competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Army Games**

 
 
• The International Army Games is an annual military sports event organized by the Russian Ministry of Defense since 2015.
 
• It includes various competitions like tank biathlon, sniper frontier, and engineering formula among others.
 
• The games aim to foster military cooperation and exchange of expertise among participating countries.
 
• Countries from around the world, including China, Iran, and India, have participated in these games.
 
 
 
• **Jaisalmer**
 
 
• Jaisalmer, also known as the "Golden City," is famous for its yellow sandstone architecture, including the Jaisalmer Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• It is located in the heart of the Thar Desert and is a popular tourist destination in Rajasthan.
 
• The city is known for its vibrant culture, traditional crafts, and the Desert Festival held annually.
 
• Jaisalmer's strategic location and desert terrain make it an ideal location for military training and exercises.
